name: overworked
description: Entry point for all dev commands; see README.md

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix e2e ci
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run --env-file ../.env uvicorn overworked.main:create_app --factory --reload
scripts.test: npm run test:backend:unit && npm run test:backend:integration && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:backend:unit: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/unit
scripts.test:backend:unit:watch: cd backend && uv run ptw --now --clear . tests/unit
scripts.test:backend:integration: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/integration
scripts.test:backend:integration:watch: cd backend && uv run ptw --now --clear . tests/integration
scripts.test:frontend:unit: cd frontend && npx vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:frontend:component: cd frontend && npx vitest run --project component
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix e2e run typecheck
